names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 martie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Teodot, Episcopul Chiriniei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Θεόδοτος επίσκοπος Κυρήνειας Κύπρου Ομολογητής και Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 2 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свештеномученик Теодот, епископ киринијски, на острву Кипру.“, with the rank word Свештеномученик and the see епископ киринијски both left off; the island is a place clause and not part of the name. What is left is the bare forename, which is all the heading gives him.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 2 марта ст. ст., name page 2219, «Святитель Феодот Киринейский, епископ, исповедник», with the rank and office words left off. The toponymic is part of the name the calendar’s index carries and stays; the day’s own line declines the forename and puts the see after it as an office. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, while the bare «Феодот» is held by `theodotus-father-of-mamas` and `theodotus-presbyter-martyr-1937`, neither of them this man.

floruit.note: doxologia.ro: «Atunci era prigonire mare înpotriva creștinilor, împărățind păgânul Liciniu (308-324), iar în Cipru era ighemon Savin». The same life dates his release from Constantine’s victory over Maxentius (312) and the liberty given to Christians (313), and says he lived «după pătimire doi ani pe scaunul său» before he died; it prints no year for his birth or his death. days.pravoslavie.ru names the same reign and writes it «нечестивого Ликиния (307 - 324)»; that is the reign and not him, and no bound is moved for it.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 2 марта ст. ст. «Сщмч. Феодота , еп. Киринейского (ок 320-326).», and its life closes «после двух лет епископского служения мирно отошел ко Господу около 326 года». The folder carried no year of death before this reading, and doxologia.ro and saint.gr give none. The «ок» is the source’s and the interval is kept as approximate; it is a peaceful death and not a martyrdom, which is the same page’s own reading.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Феодота , еп. Киринейского (ок 320-326).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 martie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Teodot, Episcopul Chiriniei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Θεόδοτος επίσκοπος Κυρήνειας Κύπρου Ομολογητής και Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 315)» and says «Μετά δύο χρόνια όμως, το 315 μ.Χ., πέθανε» — two years after his release under Constantine the Great he died, in 315. That is a single year where the corpus's own dates, read off doxologia as the persecution under Licinius, give an interval; the corpus's reading is left as it stands and saint.gr's year is recorded here. The page names the governor Sabinus who arrested and tortured him, has him make a small flock inside the prison, and prints the distich «Ἄθλου πέπλησαι, Θεόδοτε, στιγμάτων, / Εἰ καὶ μὲτ εἰρήνης σε Χριστὸς λαμβάνει». Beside him it links Triphyllius, bishop of Ledra, who is not named in the notice itself.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.03.2026 (2. март ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Теодот, епископ киринијски, на острву Кипру.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry. The heading carries the see, which is left out of the stored name form along with the rank word; `theodotus-of-marcianopolis` already stores the same bare Serbian form off a line of its own, so this is a deliberate fold of two folders on one form, told apart by `display_name`, by slug and by see. The Prologue closes the entry with the year 302, which lies outside the interval this folder already holds from the Romanian life, and which the Prologue's own sentences stand against; the interval was not written over and the life says why.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Teodot, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Teodot, Episcopul Chiriniei

english.text: Sharing in the ways of the Apostles and succeeding to their thrones, thou didst find, O God-inspired one, a work that lifts the gaze to the things on high. Therefore, teaching the word of truth aright and enduring in the faith even unto blood, O Hieromartyr Theodotus, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Моря зловерие обличил еси,/ и идольскаго безбожия лесть верою правоверия уязвил еси/ и, всесожжение Божественное быв,/ чудодействием орошаеши концы,/ отче святителю Феодоте, Христа Бога моли// даровати нам велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 марта ст. ст. — «Кондак священномученика Феодота»

english.text: You rebuked the sea of false belief, and with the faith of right belief you wounded the deceit of the godlessness of idols; and having become a divine whole-burnt offering, you water the ends of the earth with the working of wonders. O father and hierarch Theodotus, pray to Christ God to grant us great mercy.
